open_decisions.question: DB2HNDL is a confirmed template (src/templates/database/db2-handling.cbl) demonstrating DB2 connect/insert/select/cursor/update/delete/commit against hard-coded example data. It has no business rules in scope. Is it retired, replaced by a framework data-access service, or kept as a developer template?

DB2HNDL is classified template (confirmed): classified as template (confirmed); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?

If DB2HNDL is kept: GAP-002 (critical) - copybook SQLCA includes itself (line 6) and defines only SQL-STATUS-CODES, not SQLCODE/SQLERRMC; GAP-098 - SQLCODE/SQLERRMC therefore have no Field ID; GAP-022 - the cursor row handler 2310-PROCESS-CURSOR-ROW (line 174) does not exist; GAP-082 - the fetch loop PERFORM UNTIL SQLCODE = +100 (line 165) does not handle negative SQLCODEs. Which SQLCA does the precompiler supply, and how should the template's cursor error handling be defined?

Copybook SQLCA (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0017) line 6 contains 'EXEC SQL INCLUDE SQLCA END-EXEC', naming itself. The included SQL communication area (SQLCODE, SQLSTATE, SQLERRMC, ...) has no layout in any reverse artifact. How should the forward design obtain the SQLCA layout and the SQLCODE/SQLSTATE semantics used by the 14 DB2 programs?
DB2HNDL FILLER_0058 is PIC X(20) with a 21-character VALUE 'DB2 ERROR - SQLCODE: ' (line 58). Should the Java constant keep the compiler-truncated 20 characters or the full literal?

GAP-092 (medium, DIAGRAM_RENDER_UNVERIFIED) is not addressed by any decision or requirement: Visual rendering of the 65 Mermaid diagrams is unverified. Acknowledge it as a known limitation (resolved_no_change) or exclude the affected units?

GAP-104 (low, DIAGRAM_INCOMPLETE) is not addressed by any decision or requirement: COMP-UNRESOLVED: all seven edges are unsupported. Acknowledge it as a known limitation (resolved_no_change) or exclude the affected units?
